callers.rationale: Provider-internal Docker CLI mechanics are the physical execution boundary.

callers.rationale: Legacy Nougat parser now requires an injected execution adapter; its default entrypoint is fail-closed until a production profile is wired.
callers.non_harness_managed_proof: The parser no longer creates a host process; the missing adapter remains an explicit blocked capability.

callers.rationale: Batch activity shares the injected execution environment instead of constructing a local registry.
callers.non_harness_managed_proof: Focused batch injection test asserts propagation to each executor.

callers.rationale: Harness deferred tool activity is bound to the composition execution environment.
callers.non_harness_managed_proof: Focused Harness runtime test checks the stored executor binding.

callers.rationale: The composition root is the only factory allowed to force the registry and explicit profile policy.
callers.non_harness_managed_proof: The factory overwrites caller kwargs with composition-owned execution controls.

callers.rationale: Inspection harness is a deterministic test/diagnostic utility and is not a production activity entrypoint.
callers.non_harness_managed_proof: The module is only imported by inspection tests and does not dispatch external tools.

callers.rationale: Dynamic Research obtains the shared durable lifecycle supervisor and parallel coordinator from LazyResearchChildRuntime before constructing the candidate-only SubAgentRuntime adapter.
callers.non_harness_managed_proof: Production child spawn, status, wait, cancel, and close calls are restricted to ParallelAgentCoordinator using the Harness-owned supervisor; SubAgentRuntime only invokes an admitted worker and persists its transcript.

callers.rationale: Existing durable event authority remains owned by runtime-event-transport; this execution-only change does not migrate or replace it.
callers.non_harness_managed_proof: Research constructs its existing durable event runtime independently of RuntimeExecutionComposition; execution wiring neither binds nor replaces that authority.
